title: Western Blot: SDS-PAGE, Wet Transfer and Overnight Primary
constraints: one orbital rocker, one tray at a time
notes: Step 10 is the afterStepWithBuffer: the sandwich is built five minutes after the run ends, not immediately, and it also waits on the soaked pads, so the trigger is a compound 'all' containing the buffered trigger. Membrane activation and the ECL mix are anchored inside longer steps with event=start plus an offset. The overnight primary is variable (12-18 h).
